name: nexo-pessoas
description: Produto full stack para gerenciamento de usuários.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n API,WEB -c blue,magenta "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.test: uv run --project backend pytest -c backend/pyproject.toml backend/tests && npm run test -w frontend
scripts.test:ci: uv run --project backend pytest -c backend/pyproject.toml backend/tests && npm run test -w frontend
scripts.lint: uv run --project backend ruff check --config backend/pyproject.toml backend
scripts.typecheck: uv run --project backend basedpyright --project backend/pyproject.toml && npm run typecheck -w frontend
